repairs.issue: 둔화가 기존 둔화를 전제하고 용 형상 조건/소유자/불길 범위가 잘못됨; 루트 교차검수에 따라 일반화염구 rule0/1에 용형상아닌 form조건을 독립 명시하여 용형상피해와 동시가산 방지
repairs.correction: 일반/용 형상 구분과 전체 OR 발동 복원; 불길 독립; 체력 소유자·불길 대상 unknown; 중첩 피해 대체 표시
repairs.quote: Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (60/65/70/75/80% Ability Power)) + 5% Max health magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus. Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals (62.5/81.25/100/118.75/137.5 + (75/81.25/87.5/93.75/100% Ability Power)) + 6.25% Max Health magic damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for 2 seconds that deals ((15 ~ 25) + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Overlapping Dragon Form explosions deal 40% damage.

proposalDecisions.reason: 챔피언·대형 몬스터 적중 또는 끝 지점 도달 OR를 복원.
용 형상 둔화도 파동의 전체 OR 발동에 맞춤.
불길은 화염구 흔적이므로 챔피언 적중 조건을 제거; 대상 unknown 유지.
